blurb: Guests can enjoy outdoor seated tastings under redwoods featuring estate-grown wines, private holiday group gatherings with optional food and tours, and immersive winery experiences with behind-the-scenes access and culinary options. The winery is located in a mountain setting with a focus on small group hospitality and authentic estate wines. Seasonal events and wine club memberships are also available.
